citations.narrative:
The attending veterinarian notified USDA that on June 24, 2026, a small number of baboons escaped their enclosure after
a staff member, while performing routine husbandry duties, inadvertently failed to secure the enclosure doors. An onsite
veterinarian observed the baboons outside their enclosure and immediately alerted facility personnel. The baboons were
safely returned to their enclosure, and all animals were accounted for. No injuries to the animals or staff were reported.
The facility must ensure that procedures for handling and husbandry of these animals prevent unauthorized escape and
maintaining the animals in a safely secured enclosure. Failure to handle animals in a careful manner may result in
physical harm or discomfort. Handling of animals must be done as carefully as possible in a manner that does not cause
trauma, behavioral stress, physical harm, or unnecessary discomfort.
CORRECTION DATE: CORRECTED AT TIME OF INCIDENT 24 JUNE 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
